tips.text: Start the Injector, Ignis and Ogris research first and farm Cryotic during the 72-hour waits.
Research in a one-player Ghost clan; bigger clans pay a multiple of the Cryotic.
Rank the Furax and Knux on Salacia, Neptune; about three runs each.
Cryotic is the real cost, though veteran accounts often have 60,000 banked from other grinds.
